summary: Alto saxophone: jazz, lofi, smooth R&B melodies
label: alto sax
body: Lead melodies with space between phrases. Breathier, lower: GeneralUser GS/Tenor Sax.

Register: MIDI 49-81 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Alto Sax, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Alto Sax") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
